items.question: Which trees are declared to be associated with a covered cluster in this construction rule?
premises: the cluster is described as covered
śamī appears in the same verse
items.inference: The verse names tamarind and arjuna among declared trees and places a covered cluster with śamī in the same rule.
uncertainties: the exact ritual function of the covered cluster is not explicit in this verse
items.plain_english: Tamarind and arjuna are declared; a cluster is covered, and śamī is named.
